She holds a silver transverse flute with both hands, positioned horizontally as she prepares to play. The setting is a coastal area during daylight, with a large concrete bridge and a forested island featuring a tall tower in the background. (2) As she plays, her eyes are focused and her mouth is delicately positioned against the flute's embouchure. Her fingers move precisely over the silver keys of the instrument. A translucent horizontal bar containing a musical score appears at the bottom of the frame, showing notes that correspond to the performance. The lighting is soft, natural, and even across the scene. (3) The musician continues her performance with gentle body sways, maintaining her position on the beach. The camera remains completely static, capturing her from a medium full shot perspective. There are no visual cuts or transitions. The background elements like the bridge and the sea remain constant and still under the overcast sky as she finishes her phrase.
